profile.headline: Software Developer | Product Engineer | SaaS Founder | Typescript / Next.js / Astro | React Native / Expo  | Cloud Architecture / AWS | Drupal / Wordpress / PHP
profile.summary:
I’m a web engineer who enjoys turning complex ideas into working software. I focus on building systems that are practical, reliable, and designed to deliver real value quickly.

My background spans modern web development, Drupal architecture, cloud platforms, and AI-driven automation. I’ve helped organizations improve accessibility, modernize legacy platforms, and build tools that streamline operations and enhance user experience.

I’ve contributed to projects supporting organizations such as the National Heart, Lung, and Blood Institute, the Delaware River and Bay Authority, and the California Department of Transportation. Whether working on large public platforms or experimental AI tools, I approach every project with the same mindset: understand the problem deeply, choose the right tools, and ship thoughtful solutions.

I’m particularly interested in systems that combine software, automation, and intelligent tooling to help teams move faster and operate more effectively.

Outside of client work, I contribute to open source and enjoy building new tools and products that explore where web technology and AI are heading next.

When I’m not coding, you’ll probably find me riding my KLR650 through the mountains or working on creative digital projects.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Deliver product design, full-stack engineering, cloud architecture, and digital marketing through Crest Code for startups, small businesses, and Colorado Digital Service.
• Built and evolved ThirdTone’s iOS, Android, and web products as paid subscriptions grew from 12 to 103 and monthly recurring revenue increased from $91 to $1,066 over the past year.
• Engineered AI personalization, subscription billing, and an audio delivery pipeline using React Native, Expo, Convex, RevenueCat, Cloudflare R2, and FFmpeg—supporting 9,000+ listening sessions and 2,000+ listening hours.
• Designed ThirdTone’s marketing website and Sanity CMS, and expanded its reachable email audience 262%, from 238 to 862 contacts, by integrating and segmenting existing app members in Kit.
• Built the Colorado Design System’s 240-token pipeline across CSS, Sass, JSON, and TypeScript, plus USWDS components, Storybook documentation, and automated accessibility checks.
• Developed multi-tenant SaaS and AI tools, including workforce scheduling, geofenced time tracking, Stripe billing, and serverless generation services using Next.js, Supabase/PostgreSQL, Python, and AWS Lambda.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description: Helped build the admin portal for Electrify, Nularian’s AI call center platform, using React/TypeScript on the frontend and Node.js/Python APIs on AWS, including dashboards that surfaced real-time operational data from a system handling 500+ calls per day.
